common_measurement_contract.native_step_logging_method: TensorBoard EventAccumulator for loss/train/total, loss/train/global_max, and l2_norm/grad/global; structured JSONL log_type_name counts for optim_end and step_end.

timer_scope.excluded: Setup and updates 1-20 warmup precede the measured start; teardown follows the measured end.
timer_scope.full_window: Per-rank monotonic interval after update 20 through update 60; the eight-rank aggregate is max(rank end) - min(rank start). The start timestamp is taken after the pre-window CUDA synchronization. The end timestamp is taken after the update-60 CUDA synchronization, so the final update drain lies inside the measured interval.
timer_scope.included: Normal MDS input, transfers, compute, communication, optimizer, and lightweight native logging for updates 21-60.
timer_scope.per_update_cadence: Host intervals between native Profiler.step callbacks. There is no per-update CUDA synchronization; the step-60 cadence interval includes the end-boundary synchronization. These are cadence measurements, not per-step synchronized device timings.

comparison.interpretation: One matched unprofiled pair only. Differences are provisional; there is no repeated identical-control pair, run-to-run noise estimate, confidence interval, or causal attribution. Within-run cadence spread is descriptive, not run-to-run uncertainty. No per-step synchronized timing was recorded.
comparison.paired_order: Baseline depth 0 then candidate depth 32, serial as recorded in the plan.
